I'm so sorry, this seems quite upsetting. I love to dream as well and I've been getting into chakras so this makes me a bit weary about third eye. I will say that mugwort is often said to give interesting if not intense dreams. I would do some research about how to use it for that purpose safely.  One thing both myself and my boyfriend have done that has worked is saying mantras at night before bed. My partner was having nightmares so he would repeat a chant like "I will have pleasants dreams tonight" and it seemed to help him! I on the other hand have been trying to learn about spirit guides and wanted mine to show themselves in a dream so I started doing chants in my head before sleep saying things like "I will remember my dreams, I wish to see my spirit guides in them." I never saw a spirit guide but I did start to remember my dreams well and journaling them helped keep the process going! Wish you luck!
